modules.description: Validate a base URL before an outbound HttpClient is created for an LLM provider
modules.precondition: The DNS test seam (LlmBaseUrlGuard.ResolveHostAddresses) is replaced with a stub in test setup

methods.requirement: Guard outbound LLM provider URLs against SSRF: reject non-http/https schemes, embedded credentials, public cleartext HTTP, and private hosts without explicit operator grant. Fail closed when DNS resolves to a mix of public and private addresses or when resolution fails.

allowPrivateHosts = false (default)
allowedPrivateOrigins = empty list
DNS stub = returns public IPv4 only (e.g. 1.2.3.4)

modules.description: Calculates the next optimal posting time per platform for the content scheduler

methods.requirement: Return the next golden-hour slot in UTC+7 for a given platform. Known platforms: facebook=20:30, tiktok=20:00, instagram=19:30, youtube=18:00, zalo=08:00. Unknown platform defaults to 19:00. If the candidate slot has already passed today, return the same slot tomorrow.

cases.precondition: No external dependencies; pure function
cases.input:
platform = "facebook"
utcNow (Vietnam time context) = before the platform golden hour today (e.g. 10:00 VN for facebook 20:30)
cases.expected: Return: today's golden hour in UTC+7 (converted to UTC)

cases.precondition: No external dependencies; pure function
cases.input:

utcNow (Vietnam time context) = after the platform golden hour today (e.g. 21:00 VN for facebook 20:30)
cases.expected: Return: tomorrow's golden hour in UTC+7 (converted to UTC)

cases.precondition: No external dependencies; pure function

cases.precondition: No external dependencies; pure function

modules.description: Recurrence engine used by AgentSchedules to compute the next run time and deduplicate runs within a window
modules.precondition: Timezone ID must be a valid IANA/Windows timezone (e.g. SE Asia Standard Time)

methods.requirement: NextRunUtc advances a UTC timestamp by one cadence unit in the given timezone. WindowKey returns a deterministic string key for the cadence window (e.g. weekly:2026-W33, quarterly:2026-Q3). Month-end dates are clamped to the last valid day of the target month.

cases.precondition: Timezone ID must be a valid IANA/Windows timezone (e.g. SE Asia Standard Time)

cadence = "daily"
fromUtc / dueAtUtc = normal date (e.g. 2026-08-11 10:00 UTC)

cases.precondition: Timezone ID must be a valid IANA/Windows timezone (e.g. SE Asia Standard Time)

modules.description: AI auto-reply state machine on the Conversation aggregate
modules.precondition: Conversation instance is in a valid state (not resolved/deleted)

methods.requirement: PauseAiAutoReplyUntil sets enabled=false and records resumeAt. TryResumeAiAutoReply returns true and clears resumeAt only when enabled=false AND resumeAt <= now. SetAiAutoReply(false) is a permanent toggle (clears resumeAt). Escalate sets enabled=false with resumeAt=null permanently.

cases.precondition: Conversation instance is in a valid state (not resolved/deleted)

resumeAt vs now = resumeAt <= now (window elapsed)

modules.description: Enforce the per-tenant monthly LLM cost cap before and during an orchestration run
modules.precondition: A fake ILlmCostTracker returns a controlled SummaryAsync result; a separate fake also implements ILlmCostReservationStore

methods.requirement: Block an orchestration run when the month-to-date spend plus the estimate would exceed the tenant cap. Treat a negative estimate as zero. Prefer the reservation store when the tracker implements it. Always write a ledger entry when there are tokens, even when the computed cost is zero, so the monthly cap cannot silently lose data.

cases.precondition: A fake ILlmCostTracker returns a controlled SummaryAsync result; a separate fake also implements ILlmCostReservationStore

method under test = CanStartAsync (preflight)
summary MonthToDate vs Cap = MonthToDate 10 + estimate 5, Cap 200 (well under)
estimatedUsd = positive value
tracker implements reservation store = no (plain tracker)
cases.expected: Outcome: Allowed is true, Reason is null

cases.precondition: A fake ILlmCostTracker returns a controlled SummaryAsync result; a separate fake also implements ILlmCostReservationStore
cases.input:
method under test = CanStartAsync (preflight)

estimatedUsd = positive value

cases.expected: Outcome: Allowed is true, Reason is null

modules.description: Validate a public media URL before it is submitted to an external publishing API
modules.precondition: A stub IHostAddressResolver is injected; the resolution timeout is shortened for the timeout case

methods.requirement: Only allow HTTPS URLs that resolve exclusively to public addresses before media is handed to a social platform. modules.description: Lock auth timing constants and confirm bound options match after PostConfigure
modules.precondition: A host is built with a deliberately wrong appsettings value for each option under test

methods.requirement: Code is the single source of truth for auth timing. The API JwtOptions and the Infrastructure RefreshTokenOptions and Identity lockout all PostConfigure from these constants, so a stray appsettings value cannot drift the access-token lifetime, clock skew, refresh window or lockout out of sync. The Gateway is isolated by ADR-007 and must carry an identical ClockSkewSeconds in its own configuration.
